summary: Design visual systems, interfaces, and motion.

skills.choose_when: The task is interface hierarchy, responsive layout, component design, UI aesthetic judgment, anti-generic visual critique, redesign, polish, or implementation of a visual reference as frontend code.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for a static poster, presentation, or backend-only task.
skills.name: design-frontend

skills.choose_when: The task explicitly concerns UI animation, transition timing, easing, motion audit, or reduced-motion behavior.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for video editing or animation unrelated to interface behavior.
skills.name: design-motion

skills.choose_when: The task needs reusable color, typography, spacing, style tokens, a brand kit, or a coherent visual system across artifacts.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use when only one isolated color value or font choice is requested.
skills.name: design-visual-theme
